fields.reasoning: The finding was confirmed by the critic: 01M6J965 is accepted and in review on cs/fix-a-run-interrupted-after, not on main, and its branch log updates the same statement and acceptance fields on four nodes this plan rewrites, and adds two nodes this plan names. Without ordering, this plan could build or land first, naming missing nodes and tests and making conflicting writes from older bases. Both change sets fix the same area (resuming runs whose change set landed), so 01M6J965 is the foundation and this one refines it; dropping the references or folding the two together would lose either plan's scope. A depends-on link plus rebasing onto 01M6J965's field versions is the smallest fix and exactly what the finding asks for.
